title: Tuesday · SpacesEDU, Career, decimals and Nevermoor
arrival: Attendance first. We have computers until 10:30; get ready to show what you have learned.
note: Computers 8:30–10:30; French/Health prep 12:35–1:35. Monday: walk complete, rounding begun, Action Packs explored; Nevermoor not started. Career SpacesEDU assignment still to create. No class walk reflection Tuesday. School closed Wednesday, September 30. SchoolAI only as an optional scaffold after an independent attempt. Teacher launches: https://ca.spacesedu.com/ and https://www.bethechangeearthalliance.org/c4c .

blocks.title: Computers · SpacesEDU learning posts
blocks.notes: Attendance first. Model a post that shows selected work, explains learning and names one next step. Finish or improve existing posts; offer an offline draft if access fails. Keep private Discovery originals offline. https://ca.spacesedu.com/
studentSteps: Choose one piece of learning you are ready to explain.
Show the work and tell what you learned or changed.
Add one next step; save your post or draft.

blocks.title: Career Education · choose an inquiry
blocks.notes: Project Monday’s signed-in Be the Change Action Pack choices. Students choose an issue, give a reason and record one inquiry question on paper or an approved draft. The Career SpacesEDU activity is not yet created; do not assign a pack. Teacher launch: https://www.bethechangeearthalliance.org/c4c .
studentSteps: Browse the Action Pack topics with the class.
Choose one issue you care about and tell why.
Write, draw or dictate a question you could investigate.

blocks.title: Save, return computers and snack
blocks.notes: Save work and return the booked computers by 10:30. Snack near 10:20 as usual; finish the transition before recess.

blocks.title: Mathematics · continue rounding decimals
blocks.notes: Continue Monday’s rounding. Model 7.264 to hundredths: thousandths 4 keeps hundredths 6, giving 7.26. Guided practice, then an independent check with explanation. If secure, compare 4.386 > 4.368 by aligning places; hundredths 8 > 6. Carry comparing forward if rounding needs the hour. Math Antics is optional; the lesson works without video.
studentSteps: Round decimals and explain which digit made the decision.
Try a few on your own and check your place values.
If ready, compare two decimals one place at a time.

blocks.title: Core French and Health Education
blocks.notes: Fixed prep block with the specialist teacher.

blocks.title: Language Arts · begin Nevermoor
blocks.notes: Begin the novel from the start. Listen to a manageable opening; pause for setting and character talk. Model a prediction supported by one heard detail. Students write, draw with a caption or dictate briefly. Carry the story forward without rushing.
studentSteps: Listen for one interesting detail about a character or the setting.
Share a prediction and the story detail that supports it.

blocks.title: Planners, jobs and dismissal
blocks.notes: Tidy, complete classroom jobs and planners, and remind students that school is closed Wednesday, September 30.

backups: If a computer sign-in stalls, draft the learning explanation and Career inquiry question on paper; return to the post later.
If rounding needs the full hour, carry comparing decimals forward rather than rushing it.
